blocks.title: Default parameter
blocks.text: Parameter ki default qeemat ho sakti hai, jo call mein argument na dene par istemal hoti hai.

blocks.title: Python code (har .... ek 4-space indent hai)
blocks.text:
def greet(name="Student"):
....return "As-Salaam-Alaikum, " + name + "!"

print(greet())          # As-Salaam-Alaikum, Student!
print(greet("Umer"))    # As-Salaam-Alaikum, Umer!

blocks.prompt: Default parameters kaise kaam karte hain, samjhaiye (short question 6).
blocks.explanation: Default definition mein likha jata hai (name="Student"). Agar bulane wala argument de to wahi qeemat istemal hoti hai; na de to default, to function kam arguments ke saath bulaya ja sakta hai.

items: Default parameters: argument na ho to istemal: greet() par 'Student'.
